summary: Yahuma territory (Tshopo province), north-west of Kisangani between the Lopori and Aruwimi/Congo basins, is remote and far from the eastern conflict zones; no armed group is known to hold territory there. The state administers Yahuma town and the territory through its secteurs, with the PNC as the main day-to-day security force and minimal FARDC presence. Local land and chieftaincy disputes may occur but are not known to have produced non-state control. Web research was unavailable for this run, so confidence is medium for Yahuma centre and low for rural villages.
